text: 盘前必读丨特朗普已通知国会伊朗战事重新爆发；国务院批复《扩大消费“十五五”规划》 机构认为，大型存储硬科技IPO落地前控制仓位，均衡配置为主。
text_en: Pre-market reading: Trump notifies Congress of renewed Iran conflict; State Council approves 15th Five-Year consumption expansion plan. Institutions advise controlling positions before large storage tech IPO, with balanced allocation.
